results.title: Is market heading towards a big AI crash like the dot-com crisis? Here's what European Central Bank predicts
results.description: The European Central Bank warns that an AI market correction on Wall Street is likely, citing historical tech bubbles like the dot-com era. Even if AI succeeds, overstretched valuations, shifting macro risks, and limited policy buffers could trigger sharp stock adjustments, impacting euro area investors.

results.title: Antarra Banerjee Clarifies Mistaken Identity In Train Arrest Case
results.description: Antarra Banerjee clarifies she was wrongly linked to a train arrest case after her photograph was misused to ETV Bharat correspondent Kirtikumar Kadam.

results.title: 46 KCP (Taibanganba) members lay down arms at ‘homecoming ceremony’ in Manipur
results.description: Manipur's Chief Minister Y Khemchand Singh took a momentous step as he welcomed forty-six militants who renounced their ties to the prohibited KCP (Taibanganba). In a heartfelt 'Homecoming Ceremony,' the state pledged to help these former combatants establish a stable livelihood, aligning with the modified surrender-cum-rehabilitation policy of 2018 to promote harmony and development.

results.title: Tejaswin Shankar, Vidit Gujrathi, Divya Deshmukh among Arjuna Awardees, no Khel Ratna this year: Full list
results.description: The Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports today announced the National Sports Awards 2025. Based on the recommendations of the Selection Committee, chaired by a former Judge of the Supreme Court of India, Justice (Retd.) Arun Kumar Mishra, the Government has decided to confer the Arjuna Awards on 17 recipients.

results.title: ‘Sigma’: Vijay’s Son Jason Sanjay’s Directorial Debut Starring Sundeep Kishan To Arrive in Theatres on THIS Date
results.description: Vijay's son Jason Sanjay's highly anticipated directorial debut, 'Sigma', starring Sundeep Kishan is now confirmed for a worldwide theatrical release on October 2, 2026. Produced by Lyca Productions with music by Thaman S, the action-comedy heist film promises a thrilling cinematic experience, having been previously postponed from its July 31 date.
